title: A webhook arriving while the agent is busy waits for idle

steps.post: @{agent} read every monthly minutes page linked from {FIX}/minutes/ and give me the total of the approved expenditures across all of them.

steps.exec: ssh unrjos@internal.clinivance.com "curl -sS -o /dev/stdout -w ' HTTP %{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/triggers -H 'Authorization: Bearer {TOKEN}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"targetAgentUsername\":\"tester-ds\",\"targetChannelId\":\"{channelId}\",\"reference\":{\"id\":\"ticket-r3-2\",\"sender\":\"monitoring\",\"subject\":\"Certificate for chat.internal expires in 9 days\",\"body\":\"The TLS certificate for chat.internal.clinivance.com expires on 30 September 2026. Renewal is automatic through Caddy; confirm nothing needs doing or say what to check.\"}}'"

steps.watch: the running turn, then the announcement and its turn

groundTruth.spec: §4.2 a trigger is posted only when the target channel is idle (no turn running, no approval pending, nothing debouncing); nothing the system bot posts enters the queue; the announcement starts a normal turn

pass: The announcement post's creation time is after the minutes turn's terminal status marker; the minutes reply gives $78,565; the announcement's turn answered from the body and called triggers::resolve; the minutes turn shows no sign of the webhook (no 👀 reaction, nothing folded in).

checks.text: posts.json: the system-bot announcement's create_at is later than the first turn's status post reaching a terminal marker (compare with events.json's last event of that turn).
The first turn's reply gives $78,565 and its trace holds no reference to the certificate ticket.
The second turn resolved the trigger and answered from the body (30 September 2026, Caddy renews) without checking anything it cannot reach.
